doc.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26

title: Ory's first night at the Los Angeles Cadillac
summary: Ory in Los Angeles with Lee Lockin, and a rival band trying to trick him on a Sunday night until Tiger Rag.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Yeah. So, Ori, one Sunday night they gets him in there, a little high or something. They got him on the stand, and I don't know what they tell me. They're throwing the vamp on the Orioles, you know. And, uh, tell them you plop down there, you know, vamp, and pick up, you know. I don't have a thing now.
No, they just knocked you off there. They didn't even know how to say what they were going to play.
Didn't give you a chance to get him there at all. No. Well, that's right.

So, finally, they came right back with Tiger Rag, you know. They tried to trick you on that first. Mm-hmm. And boy, then I knew they was going to play, and they were playing in the right key, you know, the ring. And that was it.
